title: Southern Grid Wildfire Prevention UAV Inspection
title_en: Southern Grid Wildfire Prevention UAV Inspection
description:
Southern Grid Wildfire Prevention UAV Inspection
During the high-risk spring wildfire season, wildfires pose a serious threat to stable grid operation and normal power supply. To strengthen the safety line for transmission corridors, Southern Grid adopted our VTOL fixed-wing UAVs to conduct intelligent inspection of 280 km of mountain transmission lines. The operation lasted 4 days and 8 sorties, identifying nearly 10 wildfire-risk points. All risks were reported in real time and handled quickly, helping prevent wildfire damage to transmission lines and protecting power-supply safety.
